facts.fact: The National Communications Authority launched a cybersecurity certification training programme (CompTIA Security+, CISM, CISSP and others) for ICT staff nominated by government institutions, run 28 March to 8 May 2026 with World Bank SCALED-UP support and AFRALTI.
